**Install (Chrome, Edge, Brave, or any Chromium browser with WebGPU):**
1. Download `feedfilter-*.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode** (top right), click **Load unpacked**, and pick the unzipped `feedfilter` folder.
3. The welcome page opens and the model (~450 MB) downloads once. Then open x.com and scroll.
